PART II: STATEMENT OF POLICY

1:

2:

- This regulation is issued pursuant

Purpose
in the Act that require the
Commission to charge fees to defray the costs of supervising and regulating financial
institutions. This regulation establishes the methodology that the Commission will use to
assess and collect the required fees.

to provisions

Scope - This regulation applies to the fees that will be assessed by the Commission
against banks operating in Palau for the costs for supervision and regulatory services.
Fees relating to licensing, changes-of-control, mergers, branch offices, and non-resident
workers are not covered by this regulation.

Responsibility - It is the responsibility of each bank operating in Palau to pay to the
Commission the full amount of the annual fee in the manner and timetable prescribed in
this regulation.
